messages.content: You are a precise biomedical information extraction assistant. Follow the requested output format exactly and never add explanations.

Find duplicate entities for the item and an alias that best represents the duplicates. Duplicates are those that are the same in meaning, such as with variation in tense, plural form, stem form, case, abbreviation, shorthand. Return an empty list if there are none.

item: "pediatric patients 12 years and older with depression"
set: ["pediatric patients 12 years and older with depression", "patients with obesity aged 12 years and older", "oral administration recommended for patients 12 years and older", "8 mg oral dose for patients 12 years and older", "weight loss and weight management patients with obesity who are 12 years and older", "adult and pediatric patients", "geriatric patients with depression", "600 mg 3 times a day for patients 12 years and older", "300 mg 3 times a day for patients 12 years and older", "13 years and older", "6 years and older", "3 years and older", "for adults and pediatric patients (10 years and older) with homozygous familial hypercholesterolemia", "adults and pediatric patients with type 1 diabetes", "pediatric patients less than 6 years old", "pediatric patients younger than 6 years with type 1 diabetes"]

Respond with a JSON object with exactly these fields:
  "duplicates": list of exact matches to items in the entities set that are duplicates of the item
  "alias": best entity name to represent the duplicates, ideally from the entities set
